definitions.explanation: Having a lot to do; occupied with tasks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忙|いそが}しい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{忙|いそが}しくて⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I'm too busy and don't have time.

examples.japanese: お{忙|いそが}しい⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧。
examples.english: Sorry to bother you when you're busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{忙|いそが}しくて、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Work has been busy lately, so I don't have time to see my friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忙|いそが}しい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{再来週|さらいしゅう}→再来週：01416_saraishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Next week I'm busy, but the week after I'm free. When would be good for you?

notes:
{忙|いそが}しい is an i-adjective meaning busy or occupied with tasks.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {忙|いそが}しく ({忙|いそが}しくなる = to become busy)
- て-form: {忙|いそが}しくて (because of being busy)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{忙|いそが}しいところ: when you're busy (polite phrase before asking)
- {忙|いそが}しくて{時間|じかん}がない: too busy to have time
- {仕事|しごと}が{忙|いそが}しい: work is busy

POLITE USAGE:
When addressing others about their busyness, add お: お{忙|いそが}しいですか?

CONTRAST:
- {忙|いそが}しい: busy
- {暇|ひま}: free, not busy
